+---
+## What
+Task order in a column. The basis is plan.md §6 (Ordinals) and §10 step 4.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Model/Ordinal.swift`: fractional index (Figma algorithm), lowercase hex, default `"80"`. Functions `first`, `after(_:)`, `before(_:)`, `between(_:_:)`.
+- Invalid input gives `INVALID_ORDINAL`.
+- Byte compatibility with Rust is not necessary.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `between(a, b)` sorts strictly between `a` and `b` for all valid inputs.
+- [ ] 1000 inserts at the same position keep a strict order.
+- [ ] An invalid ordinal gives `INVALID_ORDINAL`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Model/OrdinalTests.swift`: port the behavior cases of `../swissarmyhammer/crates/swissarmyhammer-kanban/src/types/position.rs`, plus a property test over random inserts.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter OrdinalTests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

@@ -1,4 +1,16 @@
 ---
+comments:
+- actor: wballard
+  id: 01m4ba2sney2tfn4cg7m6cp5jq
+  text: |-
+    Research done.
+    - Rust `types/position.rs` wraps the `fractional_index` 2.0.2 crate. Its algorithm: bytes end with the terminator 0x80; text = lowercase hex of all bytes; `default` = [0x80] = "80"; `new_before`/`new_after` cut at the first byte on the far side of 0x80 or step one byte; `new_between` returns None for equal or misordered inputs. Rust `Ordinal::between` then falls back to `before(after)`. Port keeps that fallback (Rust test `test_ordinal_between_equal_inputs_falls_back_to_before`).
+    - Rust `hex_to_bytes` ignores an odd last character, and `new_between` does `right[i] - 1` on u8 (it can overflow). The Swift port refuses odd length and uses Int arithmetic.
+    - Rust `from_string` silently gives `first()` for bad text. plan.md §6 and this card say invalid input gives INVALID_ORDINAL, so the Swift parse throws `KanbanError.invalidOrdinal(ordinal:)` (case already in GraphQL/Errors.swift).
+    - Rust `Position` (column + ordinal) is not in this card. ColumnId does not exist yet, so the Position tests are not ported here.
+    - API shape: the card names `after(_:)`, `before(_:)`, `between(_:_:)`. The requester also gave the review rule "label the first argument of an init or function unless it is a value-preserving conversion" and "attach the preposition to the argument label". To obey both, the operations keep the card names as labels: `Ordinal.first`, `Ordinal(after:)`, `Ordinal(before:)`, `Ordinal(between:and:)`, `Ordinal(parsing:)`.
+    - Tests reuse `SplitMix64` from Tests/.../Body/UnifiedDiffTests.swift for the seeded property test.
+  timestamp: 2026-10-07T13:50:38.766932+00:00
 depends_on:
 - 01M4B3V22A3PCQRESESTYBQ2FH
 - 01M4B4A8735GAP57Q8ZVDP5HY2
